info.title: Kaneo API
info.description: Kaneo Project Management API - Manage projects, tasks, labels, and more

ApiKeyRateLimited.description: The API key exceeded its rate limit or usage quota. Wait the number of seconds in Retry-After before retrying. The X-RateLimit headers are sent only when the rate limit was hit.

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Omitted when an exhausted usage quota never refills.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests the API key may make per window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix time in seconds when the current window resets.

code.description: Stable UPPER_SNAKE_CASE code. Derived from the status unless a more specific code applies, such as VALIDATION_ERROR or MISSING_PERMISSION.

path.description: Dotted path to the invalid input, prefixed with the request part (body, query, params, header).

missingPermissions.description: Permissions the caller lacks for this route, as resource:action, for MISSING_PERMISSION and API_KEY_SCOPE.

descriptionDeferred.description: True when the list omits a large description; load the task detail or description pages to read it. Do not replace stored text with this null summary.

priority.description: One of: no-priority, low, medium, high, urgent.

estimateSeconds.description: Total effort in seconds, in whole-minute increments. Null clears the estimate; independent of the displayed hours/days unit.

createdBy.description: The user who created the task. Null for work created by integrations or before Kaneo recorded it.

type.description: A feature groups tasks and bugs of its own project. A task or bug can belong to one feature.

featureId.description: The feature this task or bug belongs to, in the same project. Always null for a feature.

milestoneId.description: A milestone within this task or bug’s Feature. Null for Features and unassigned items.

releaseId.description: The Task/Bug release, from its own project. Always null for Features and on public boards.

subtaskCounts.description: For a feature, its tasks and bugs and how many are in a final column; zero for a task or bug. Counts all members, whatever the board's filters.

metadata.description: Provider-specific payload, already parsed from the stored JSON string.

relatedRevision.description: Public board labels and external links revision for this task page. Restart pagination if it changes during related-page continuations.

revision.description: Public board content, membership and ordering revision, including related records and feature progress. Restart pagination if it changes between task or related pages.

BoardPagination.description: Always paginated: 50 tasks by default, at most 100 per page. Continue through totalPages to retrieve all tasks. For each task page, follow relatedPage through relatedTotalPages to retrieve all labels, external links and columns (100 related rows per kind per request, plus up to 100 columns needed to represent the tasks).

descriptionDeferred.description: True when a project description above 64 KiB is omitted; use project detail or public project description pages for full text.

triageTasks.description: Tasks and Bugs waiting in Triage for a triage member to accept or decline. Always empty on public boards.

hasImageUploads.description: Whether S3-compatible storage is configured, so task images and board backgrounds can be uploaded.

customOAuthName.description: Label for the custom OAuth provider on the sign-in page. Null means the generic SSO label.

hasAssistant.description: Whether the workspace assistant is available on this instance. False when DISABLE_ASSISTANT is true. Each workspace still needs an admin to save an OpenRouter key before members can chat.

redirect.description: Where to send the browser next: back to the client with a code on approval, or with an error on denial.

idToken.description: The stored id_token for the user's `custom` OAuth account, or null when they have no such account.

slug.description: Short prefix used in task identifiers, e.g. KAN-12.

ReleaseWithProgress.description: A planned delivery in one project, holding milestones, Tasks and Bugs. Dates are calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD) with no time zone, ordered start ≤ code freeze ≤ submission. The phase isn't stored: compare the viewer's local today with the dates. Upcoming before the start date; in progress from the start date until the day before code freeze; code freeze from the code freeze date through the submission date; past submission after the submission date.

Release.description: A planned delivery in one project, holding milestones, Tasks and Bugs. Dates are calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD) with no time zone, ordered start ≤ code freeze ≤ submission. trackedFrom.description: Tracking began at this instant. Earlier totals are unknown.

post.description: Create a chat with its first message and stream the assistant's answer. The assistant reads the workspace as the caller, with the caller's permissions. Changes it proposes wait as pending tool messages until the caller approves them with POST /chats/{chatId}/decisions; the stream then ends with `done` and their count. Every refusal is answered as JSON before the chat is created, so a refused request leaves no chat. The stream's first event is `chat` with the new chat's id. Stopping the request stops the answer; what streamed so far is kept.

content.description: The message, up to 8,000 characters. NUL characters are refused.

timeZone.description: The browser's IANA time zone, used for dates and times in answers. A zone the server doesn't know falls back to UTC.

200.description: Server-Sent Events, each one `data:` line of JSON (AssistantStreamEvent): `chat` (POST /chats only, first), `delta` (answer text), `message` (a saved message to insert or replace by id), then exactly one `done` or `error`. Error events carry a code and whether a retry may help, never upstream text. `: ping` comments keep the connection alive.

post.description: Approve or reject changes the assistant proposed in one of the caller's chats. Each decided change leaves pending exactly once, so a repeated or concurrent request runs nothing twice. Approved changes run in the order they were proposed, as the caller with the caller's current permissions; one that fails writes nothing and reports the API's error. Updates of text without a conflict check fail without writing when the text changed since the proposal, and a task archived since stays archived. No write starts after about 10 seconds: those changes stay pending. Messages of other chats are ignored. Call Continue afterwards when `resumable` is true.

messageId.description: A tool message of the chat that waits for approval.

approve.description: True runs the change as the caller; false rejects it.

decisions.description: Up to 10 decisions. Approved changes run in the order they were proposed.
